name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 5.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on using different methods to store and process data for a variety of purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on using different methods to store and process data for a variety of purposes

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 5, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: analyse impacts of various social and environmental factors, human activities, and technologies on human health
overall_expectations.text_html: analyse impacts of various social and environmental factors, human activities, and technologies on human health

specific_expectations.text: assess effects of a variety of social and environmental factors on human health, and describe ways in which individuals can reduce the harmful effects of these factors and take advantage of those that are beneficial
specific_expectations.text_html: assess effects of a variety of social and environmental factors on human health, and describe ways in which individuals can reduce the harmful effects of these factors and take advantage of those that are beneficial

specific_expectations.text: evaluate beneficial and harmful effects of various technologies on human health and body systems, while taking different perspectives into consideration
specific_expectations.text_html: evaluate beneficial and harmful effects of various technologies on human health and body systems, while taking different perspectives into consideration

specific_expectations.text: explain how food literacy can support decisions that affect physical and mental health
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how food literacy can support decisions that affect physical and mental health

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the structure and function of human body systems and interactions within and between systems
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the structure and function of human body systems and interactions within and between systems

specific_expectations.text: identify systems of the human body, and describe their basic function
specific_expectations.text_html: identify systems of the human body, and describe their basic function

specific_expectations.text: describe the basic structure and function of vital organs in various systems in the human body
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the basic structure and function of vital organs in various systems in the human body

specific_expectations.text: describe interrelationships between human body systems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe interrelationships between human body systems

specific_expectations.text: identify various diseases and medical disorders in humans and the organs and/or body system or systems that they affect
specific_expectations.text_html: identify various diseases and medical disorders in humans and the organs and/or body system or systems that they affect

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impacts on society and the environment of various processes and materials used in the manufacture of common products, and ways to mitigate negative impacts
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts on society and the environment of various processes and materials used in the manufacture of common products, and ways to mitigate negative impacts

specific_expectations.text: assess the impacts on society and the environment of various processes used in the manufacture of common products
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts on society and the environment of various processes used in the manufacture of common products

specific_expectations.text: assess how the use of specific materials in the manufacture of common products affects the environment, and identify actions that society and individuals can take to mitigate negative impacts
specific_expectations.text_html: assess how the use of specific materials in the manufacture of common products affects the environment, and identify actions that society and individuals can take to mitigate negative impacts

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of matter, changes of state, and physical and chemical change
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the properties of matter, changes of state, and physical and chemical change

specific_expectations.text: describe matter as everything that has mass and occupies volume
specific_expectations.text_html: describe matter as everything that has mass and occupies volume

specific_expectations.text: identify the states of matter, and describe characteristics and properties of solids, liquids, and gases
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the states of matter, and describe characteristics and properties of solids, liquids, and gases

specific_expectations.text: describe changes of state of matter observed at home, in the community, or in the natural environment
specific_expectations.text_html: describe changes of state of matter observed at home, in the community, or in the natural environment

specific_expectations.text: describe physical changes in matter as changes of the state, volume, or form of the matter that do not result in the formation of a different substance
specific_expectations.text_html: describe physical changes in matter as changes of the state, volume, or form of the matter that do not result in the formation of a different substance

specific_expectations.text: describe chemical changes in matter as changes that result in the formation of different substances, and identify signs that a chemical change has occurred
specific_expectations.text_html: describe chemical changes in matter as changes that result in the formation of different substances, and identify signs that a chemical change has occurred

specific_expectations.text: explain how changes of state can occur when matter absorbs or releases thermal energy
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how changes of state can occur when matter absorbs or releases thermal energy

specific_expectations.text: explain why specific physical properties of various solids, liquids, and gases make them useful for particular applications
specific_expectations.text_html: explain why specific physical properties of various solids, liquids, and gases make them useful for particular applications

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: analyse social and environmental impacts of forces acting on structures, and assess ways to mitigate these impacts
overall_expectations.text_html: analyse social and environmental impacts of forces acting on structures, and assess ways to mitigate these impacts

specific_expectations.text: analyse the effects of forces from natural phenomena on structures in natural and built environments
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse the effects of forces from natural phenomena on structures in natural and built environments

specific_expectations.text: assess various ways in which humans mitigate impacts of forces from natural phenomena on structures in urban, rural, and remote communities
specific_expectations.text_html: assess various ways in which humans mitigate impacts of forces from natural phenomena on structures in urban, rural, and remote communities

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of forces that act on structures, and how various structures withstand them
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of forces that act on structures, and how various structures withstand them

specific_expectations.text: identify internal forces acting on a structure, and describe their effects on the structure
specific_expectations.text_html: identify internal forces acting on a structure, and describe their effects on the structure

specific_expectations.text: identify external forces acting on a structure, and describe their effects on the structure
specific_expectations.text_html: identify external forces acting on a structure, and describe their effects on the structure

specific_expectations.text: describe forces resulting from natural phenomena that can have severe consequences for human-built structures, and identify structural features and materials that can allow such structures to withstand these forces
specific_expectations.text_html: describe forces resulting from natural phenomena that can have severe consequences for human-built structures, and identify structural features and materials that can allow such structures to withstand these forces

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which physical characteristics of various animal and plant species help to protect them from potentially harmful effects of forces
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which physical characteristics of various animal and plant species help to protect them from potentially harmful effects of forces

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which protective equipment helps to protect humans from potentially harmful effects of forces
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which protective equipment helps to protect humans from potentially harmful effects of forces

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess effects of energy and resource use on society and the environment, and suggest options for conserving energy and resources
overall_expectations.text_html: assess effects of energy and resource use on society and the environment, and suggest options for conserving energy and resources

specific_expectations.text: analyse long-term impacts of human uses of energy and natural resources, on society and the environment, including climate change, and suggest ways to mitigate these impacts
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse long-term impacts of human uses of energy and natural resources, on society and the environment, including climate change, and suggest ways to mitigate these impacts

specific_expectations.text: evaluate effects of various technologies on energy consumption, and describe ways in which individuals can use technology to reduce energy consumption
specific_expectations.text_html: evaluate effects of various technologies on energy consumption, and describe ways in which individuals can use technology to reduce energy consumption

specific_expectations.text: analyse how First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities use their knowledges and ways of knowing to conserve energy and resources
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse how First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities use their knowledges and ways of knowing to conserve energy and resources

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 5, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the conservation of energy, and the forms, sources, and uses of energy and resources
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the conservation of energy, and the forms, sources, and uses of energy and resources

specific_expectations.text: identify a variety of forms of energy, and describe how each form is used in everyday life
specific_expectations.text_html: identify a variety of forms of energy, and describe how each form is used in everyday life

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the law of conservation of energy, including how energy cannot be created or destroyed but can only be transformed from one form to another
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the law of conservation of energy, including how energy cannot be created or destroyed but can only be transformed from one form to another

specific_expectations.text: describe how energy is stored as potential energy and transformed in a given device or system
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how energy is stored as potential energy and transformed in a given device or system

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that when energy is transformed from one form to another, some energy may dissipate into the environment in the form of heat, light, and/or sound energy
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that when energy is transformed from one form to another, some energy may dissipate into the environment in the form of heat, light, and/or sound energy

specific_expectations.text: identify renewable and non-renewable sources of energy
specific_expectations.text_html: identify renewable and non-renewable sources of energy

specific_expectations.text: explain how the use of energy derived from fossil fuels changes the composition of the atmosphere and how these changes contribute to climate change
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how the use of energy derived from fossil fuels changes the composition of the atmosphere and how these changes contribute to climate change
